messages:
isabel: Quick sync  noticed user confusion in support tickets: they mix up client timeouts and server 429 Retry-After. Our docs show `timeout_seconds`, `deadlineMs`, and `context.WithTimeout` in different spots. Can we standardize examples for copy/paste?

mira: For HTTP/JS/Python quickstarts let's use `timeout_ms` so units are explicit.

sam: +1. For Go keep idiomatic context but add a comment: `// equivalent to timeout_ms=3000`.

denis: Streaming caveat: client aborts stop the local reader but the server might continue producing tokens; that can lead to partial billing / side-effects. Add a short note in streaming + errref.

isabel: Action items: mira to open PR updating quickstarts & errref conversion table; sam to run snippet-lint and fix embedded Gists; denis to draft the streaming paragraph. Aim to merge by Wed.

docs-bot: docs-bot: Created PR checklist: [ ] unify snippets to `timeout_ms`, [ ] Go mapping comment, [ ] add streaming abort caveat, [ ] update errref conversion table, [ ] run snippet-lint + link-check.

mira: Opened WIP PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2461. Replaced mixed params in quickstarts and added a tiny mapping table: `timeout_ms:3000` -> `timeout_seconds=3` -> `context.WithTimeout(ctx,3*time.Second)`. Left TODOs for Gists.

sam: Found 2 `deadline` occurrences inside a Gist and one CLI flag `--timeout-secs`. I'll patch those in review.

denis: Drafted streaming note: "Client timeout = client-side abort. Server Retry-After = server-advised retry delay. For streaming requests, canceling the client may still allow server-side generation to complete; take care with side-effects and billing." Paste into PR comment.

isabel: Great. If link-check flags param name links, let's add a short mapping section in the SDK reference. Notify SRE if any examples reference deprecated runtime flags.

docs-bot: docs-bot: PR #2461 updated, snippet-lint queued.
